entities.name: 628-aa query sequence
observations: Sequence analysis computed length 628 aa, estimated mass 71.56 kDa, and theoretical pI 8.72.
N-terminal residues 1–265 align to Danio rerio 3-hydroxyanthranilate 3,4-dioxygenase (Q5U3F8) at 76.2% identity; hit spans 42.2% of the full query.

C-terminal residues about 324–608 align to HCAR-family GPCRs, including human HCAR2, at about 45% identity; sequence contains several strongly hydrophobic segments compatible with a multi-pass membrane region.

No annotation passed transfer filters; full-length identity and biological integrity remain uncertain. Combined similarity pattern may indicate a fusion or unusual/chimeric protein, but this is not proven.
